title: Arkansas Public Employees' Retirement System (Arkansas Code, Title 24, Chapter 4)
verified_how: Expanded 'Title 24 Retirement and Pensions' in the official public-access table of contents: 'Chapter 4 Arkansas Public Employees' Retirement System', alongside Chapter 2 (Public Employee Retirement Plans Generally), Chapter 7 (Retirement of Employees of Schools and Educational Institutions) and Chapter 10 (Arkansas Local Police and Fire Retirement System); Chapter 3 is shown as '[Repealed.]' while Chapter 4 is not.
notes: Public employees only. Private pensions (ERISA) and Social Security are federal. Table-of-contents-level verification only (see access_notes).
